<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919633_theRebbe_834" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919633_theRebbe_834__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Introductory heading with the acronym "B'Siyata D'Shmaya" (with Divine assistance).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Explains that the future swallowing up of death is linked to the removal of the spirit of impurity, and that the sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a mixture of good and evil, introducing death to prevent the eternal existence of evil.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">“He will swallow up death forever, and the Lord G-d will wipe away tears from all faces.”</t>
    <t s="1">And the Rebbe Maharash explains in his discourse beginning with the words “Zeh” (this),</t>
    <t s="2">that this future swallowing up of death forever is because then “and the</t>
    <t s="3">spirit of impurity I will remove from the earth.”</t>
    <t s="4">And this will be understood by prefacing the reason explained in the verse</t>
    <t s="5">(later)</t>
    <t s="6">that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, death came into the world,</t>
    <t s="7">meaning that death and the sin of the Tree of Knowledge are related to each other.</t>
    <t s="8">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="9">that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, a mixture of good and evil was made.</t>
    <t s="10">For the existence of evil existed also before the sin,</t>
    <t s="11">except that then evil was separate from good,</t>
    <t s="12">as is known,</t>
    <t s="13">that at the beginning of creation, the realm of the shells was below the worlds of holiness,</t>
    <t s="14">and through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, a mixture of good and evil was made</t>
    <t s="15">(in the entire world),</t>
    <t s="16">so that evil is mixed with good and good with evil,</t>
    <t s="17">to the point that there is no good without evil and no evil without good.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is what is written,</t>
    <t s="19">“And now, lest he send forth his hand and take also from the Tree of Life and eat, and live forever.”</t>
    <t s="20">For at first glance,</t>
    <t s="21">the creation of man</t>
    <t s="22">(from the outset)</t>
    <t s="23">was in a manner that he would live forever,</t>
    <t s="24">and the reason he was commanded not to eat from the Tree of Knowledge was so that he would not die</t>
    <t s="25">(as it is written,</t>
    <t s="26">“and from the Tree of Knowledge… you shall not eat from it, for on the day you eat from it you shall surely die”),</t>
    <t s="27">so what difference does it make if he eats from the Tree of Life and lives forever?</t>
    <t s="28">And the Alter Rebbe explains,</t>
    <t s="29">that since through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge evil became mixed into man,</t>
    <t s="30">therefore,</t>
    <t s="31">“and now”</t>
    <t s="32">(after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge)</t>
    <t s="33">there is a concern lest he send forth his hand… and live forever,</t>
    <t s="34">for if he were to live forever,</t>
    <t s="35">the evil mixed within him would also have eternal existence.</t>
    <t s="36">And based on this, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="37">that this—that through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge death came into the world—was so that evil would not have permanence,</t>
    <t s="38">as above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Explains that death resulted naturally from the sin because evil is spiritual death, and the future removal of evil will cause the cessation of physical death as well.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the death in the world that came about through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge was caused by the sin itself.</t>
    <t s="2">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="3">that the matter of life is specifically in holiness,</t>
    <t s="4">but evil and impurity</t>
    <t s="5">(the opposite of holiness)</t>
    <t s="6">are death,</t>
    <t s="7">therefore,</t>
    <t s="8">since through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge evil became mixed into man,</t>
    <t s="9">spiritual death,</t>
    <t s="10">from this there also devolved upon him physical death.</t>
    <t s="11">And this is also that which in the future death will be swallowed up forever,</t>
    <t s="12">for since then evil will be nullified,</t>
    <t s="13">spiritual death,</t>
    <t s="14">through this there will automatically also be the swallowing up of physical death.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
